Note that `\s` also matches hyphens? No — `\s` matches whitespace (space, \t, \n, \r, etc.), not hyphens. So existing hyphens are preserved. Digits are preserved by `\s+` too since they're not whitespace. Good.

Now let me verify the fix runs correctly with the CLI and all tests.
